entries.title: Naming by saju (작명)
entries.content: Some Korean parents ask a naming expert to pick a name whose Hanja meanings and elements balance the baby's saju, such as adding Water if Water is missing.
entries.label: Culture - education

entries.title: Generation names (돌림자)
entries.content: Many families share one syllable across siblings or cousins of the same generation, chosen from a family register.
entries.label: Culture - education

entries.title: Family name first
entries.content: Korean names put the family name first, then usually a two-syllable given name, like Kim Min-jun.
entries.label: Culture - education

entries.title: Hanja meanings
entries.content: Most given names have Chinese characters (Hanja) behind them. The same sound can carry very different meanings depending on the character.
